# powl_loop_operator

*Part of the [beam4pm types reference](../beam4pm_types_reference.md). GENERATED by ggen_igniter -- do not edit.*

Represents a guarded POWL loop with a bounded exit condition.

| Field | Type | Required | Doc |
|---|---|---|---|
| `operator_id` | `string` | yes | Loop operator identity. |
| `body_digest` | `string` | yes | Digest of loop body operators. |
| `exit_predicate` | `string` | yes | Predicate terminating the loop. |
